turns.reply: The regex in `rich/cells.py` has two range typos: `\u0020-\u006f` should end at `\u007e` (the end of printable ASCII), and `\u00a0\u02ff` is missing the `-` making it a range. I'll fix both.

turns.reply: The fix corrects the single-width fast-path regex in `rich/cells.py`: the ASCII range now ends at `\u007e` instead of `\u006f`, and `\u00a0-\u02ff` is a proper range again instead of two separate code points. The cells tests pass (7/7), and a quick check confirms ASCII with `~` and Cyrillic/Latin-1 text match the fast path while CJK text does not. The patch is submitted (1 file changed).
